acceptedAnswer.text: Permits for Craftsman home restoration in areas like Garden City depend on the extent of the work. Major structural changes, electrical upgrades, plumbing alterations, or significant exterior modifications typically require permits from the local building department. We can help you understand the specific requirements for your project, and our team will work to ensure all necessary permits are obtained before construction begins. This ensures compliance with local regulations and smooth project progression.
